name: Riverpark Shopping Center
summary: Riverpark Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in Sugar Land, Texas, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. Strategically located along Southwest Freeway, the center provides convenient access to shopping and services for one of Houston's most affluent suburban communities.
demographics: Riverpark Shopping Center serves the affluent Sugar Land community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws heavily from young professionals and established families aged 30-55 who value convenience and quality in their daily shopping needs. The center's location along Southwest Freeway provides easy access for suburban residents seeking neighborhood retail services, with shoppers typically making frequent visits for grocery runs, dining, and essential services rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Riverpark Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located at 19900 Southwest Freeway in Sugar Land, Texas, one of Houston's most prosperous suburban communities. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, Riverpark serves as a convenient hub for daily shopping needs in this thriving area. The center's strategic location along the Southwest Freeway provides excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding residential neighborhoods, making it a go-to destination for local families and professionals. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Riverpark Shopping Center offers a practical mix of retail and service tenants designed to meet the everyday needs of Sugar Land residents. The center exemplifies the modern neighborhood shopping experience, combining convenience, accessibility, and quality tenants to serve one of Texas's most dynamic and growing communities.
